summary: AHPRA registered doctors and a clear non surgical focus are strong, but unfinished page details and a thin booking form appear to cost you consultations.

findings.problem: The cookie banner shows Manage {vendor_count} vendors and {title} entries, and the Explore Our Treatments button links back to the same page.
findings.cost: Unfilled code on the first screen looks careless for a medical brand.
findings.fix: A clean banner and buttons that open the right page.

findings.problem: The principal doctor appears as Dr Michael Khela, Dr Michael and Registered as Dr Moheb Khela, and the footer reads Flawless Aesthetics Clinics and Flawless Aesthetic.
findings.cost: Changing names weaken trust and make the clinic harder to find.
findings.fix: One consistent name for the clinic and each doctor.

findings.problem: The booking form asks only name, email, phone and concerns. It has no clinic or time choice, and no WhatsApp option appears.
findings.cost: Patients who are ready to book must wait for a call back and some will leave.
findings.fix: A booking form with clinic and time choice plus a WhatsApp button.

findings.problem: The page claims more than 5,000 non surgical nose procedures but shows no reviews, ratings or captioned results, and several images appear to be blank placeholders.
findings.cost: Cosmetic clients choose on real proof and see none.
findings.fix: A review wall and captioned results with consent.

redesign: One clear page per treatment with a booking button on each.
A booking form with clinic and time choice and a WhatsApp option.
Real reviews and captioned results near every call to action.
